title: United's Basic First Class Nickel-and-Dimes You, Heathrow's Terminal Shuffle Gets Messier, and Two Planes Kiss at LAX
summary: United rolls out "basic" first class, because apparently the front of the plane needed a bait-and-switch fare too. Plus, SkyTeam publicly rips Heathrow over its terminal reshuffle, a Delta A350 wedges its wingtip into an Air Canada 777 at LAX, and Delta explains why it's the one legacy carrier skipping the hottest plane in the industry right now.
